name: Backstop
description: A safety net for a ParyonUSD loan: a BCH reserve that tops up the loan's collateral before liquidation. Anyone can send a rescue; only the owner can withdraw.

resources.name: Backstop source
resources.description: The covenant, its tests and the keeper.

resources.name: ParyonUSD contracts
resources.description: The loan contracts a rescue adds collateral to.

owner.name: Borrower
owner.description: The owner of the ParyonUSD loan. Sets up and withdraws the vault.

keeper.name: Keeper
keeper.description: Anyone who sends a rescue. Needs no keys and no funds: fees come from the reserve, within the owner's limit.

protectLoan.name: Protect my loan
protectLoan.description: Move your loan key and a BCH reserve into a Backstop vault. If your loan falls below $(<triggerRatioBps> <100> OP_DIV)% collateral, part of the reserve moves into it.

rescue.name: Rescue a loan
rescue.description: Add $(<topUpSatoshis>) satoshis from a Backstop reserve to its ParyonUSD loan. The vault's covenant accepts only a correct rescue.

withdraw.name: Withdraw everything
withdraw.description: Take your loan key and the whole reserve back. Your loan will no longer be protected.

setupTransaction.name: Loan protected
setupTransaction.description: Moved the loan key and $(<reserveSatoshis>) satoshis into a Backstop vault.

rescueTransaction.name: Loan rescued
rescueTransaction.description: Added $(<topUpSatoshis>) satoshis from the reserve to the loan.

withdrawTransaction.name: Withdrawn
withdrawTransaction.description: Took the loan key and the reserve back from the Backstop vault.

walletLoanKeyInput.name: Loan key
walletLoanKeyInput.description: The minting NFT that controls the ParyonUSD loan, from the owner's wallet.

priceInput.name: Paryon price contract
priceInput.description: Shares the latest oracle price with the transaction.

sidecarInput.name: Loan sidecar
sidecarInput.description: Ties the loan to its loan key.

vaultKeyRescueInput.name: Vault: loan key
vaultKeyRescueInput.description: The loan key, lent to this rescue and returned unchanged.

vaultReserveRescueInput.name: Vault: reserve
vaultReserveRescueInput.description: The BCH reserve that funds the top-up and the capped fee.

vaultKeyOutput.name: Vault: loan key
vaultKeyOutput.description: The loan key, held by the Backstop vault.

setupDataOutput.name: Vault rules
setupDataOutput.description: The vault's rules, published so anyone can find and rescue it.

loanOutput.name: ParyonUSD loan
loanOutput.description: The loan, with $(<topUpSatoshis>) more satoshis of collateral.

rescueReserveOutput.name: Vault: reserve
rescueReserveOutput.description: What is left of the reserve after this rescue.

returnKeyOutput.name: Loan key
returnKeyOutput.description: Your loan key, back in your wallet.

returnReserveOutput.name: Reserve
returnReserveOutput.description: Your reserve, back in your wallet.

vault.name: Backstop vault
vault.description: Holds the loan key and the reserve. Anyone may rescue the loan with it; only the owner may withdraw.

paryonPrice.name: Paryon price contract
paryonPrice.description: Paryon's on-chain BCH/USD price, updated from signed oracle messages.

paryonLoan.name: ParyonUSD loan
paryonLoan.description: A Paryon loan: its BCH collateral and its 27-byte state.

paryonSidecar.name: Loan sidecar
paryonSidecar.description: Carries the loan key category next to its loan.

paryonManage.name: Paryon manage function
paryonManage.description: Paryon's repay / add / remove collateral logic.

keeperReward.name: Keeper reward
keeperReward.description: Where the keeper wants its reward.

ownerReturn.name: Your wallet
ownerReturn.description: Where the loan key and reserve go on withdraw.

scripts.setupPayload: <0x01> <ownerPkh> OP_CAT <loanKeyCategory> OP_CAT <paryonTokenId> OP_CAT <0x23> OP_CAT <paryonManageLocking> OP_CAT <triggerRatioBps> <2> OP_NUM2BIN OP_CAT <targetRatioBps> <2> OP_NUM2BIN OP_CAT <maxTopUpSatoshis> <8> OP_NUM2BIN OP_CAT <maxOverheadSatoshis> <4> OP_NUM2BIN OP_CAT <cooldownBlocks> <2> OP_NUM2BIN OP_CAT

ownerKey.name: Vault owner key
ownerKey.description: The key that may withdraw from the vault.

ownerPkh.name: Owner key hash
ownerPkh.description: HASH160 of the vault owner key's public key (20 bytes). Must match ownerKey for withdraw to work.

loanKeyCategory.name: Loan key
loanKeyCategory.description: Token category of the ParyonUSD loan key (display order).

paryonTokenId.name: Paryon token category
paryonTokenId.description: Paryon's token category on this network (display order).

oraclePublicKey.name: Oracle key
oraclePublicKey.description: Public key the Paryon price contract accepts.

migrationKeyCategory.name: Price contract migration key
migrationKeyCategory.description: Migration-key category the price contract was built with (display order).

triggerRatioBps.name: Rescue level
triggerRatioBps.description: A rescue is allowed while the loan's collateral ratio is below this, in basis points (12500 = 125%).

targetRatioBps.name: Target level
targetRatioBps.description: A rescue may lift the loan to at most this ratio, in basis points (15000 = 150%).

maxTopUpSatoshis.name: Most per rescue
maxTopUpSatoshis.description: Most satoshis one rescue may move into the loan.

maxOverheadSatoshis.name: Fee limit
maxOverheadSatoshis.description: Most satoshis one rescue may spend on miner fee plus keeper reward.

cooldownBlocks.name: Time between rescues
cooldownBlocks.description: Blocks the reserve must age before it can fund another rescue.

priceCommitment.name: Price contract state
priceCommitment.description: Current state of the Paryon price contract thread used (9 bytes).

loanCommitment.name: Loan state
loanCommitment.description: The loan's 27-byte state, which must stay unchanged.

topUpSatoshis.name: Top-up
topUpSatoshis.description: Satoshis this rescue moves into the loan.

keeperRewardSatoshis.name: Keeper reward
keeperRewardSatoshis.description: Satoshis the keeper takes for sending the rescue.

returnLockingScript.name: Your address
returnLockingScript.description: Where the loan key and reserve go on withdraw.
